title: onSuccessUpdateEmail: keys treated as Email IDs, not EmailSubmission IDs
description: RFC 8621 §7.5: onSuccessUpdateEmail keys are EmailSubmission IDs (or creation refs like #c1), but submission.rs:361 treats them as Email IDs directly. backend.update_object::<Email> is called with the submission creation ID as the email ID — these IDs don't exist in the Email store, so every update silently goes into email_not_updated. No email ever gets updated via onSuccessUpdateEmail.
